answer: In a hill town, visitors wander terrace lanes under copper roofs with one licensed walking guide holding a single municipal guide badge earned with a history exam, a first aid course, and a background check, and the badge number sits on every ticket. The city registry logs each booking beside the key, so a second key claiming the same badge voids both. A forger wanting a thousand fake names would need a thousand badges, each costing about $250 in fees plus a first aid course and weeks of study, so a thousand fake names need a thousand licensed guides.
